model.name: Wan2.2 Animate 2 14B Distilled
model.description: Animate 2 Distilled quickly brings a character image to life by transferring body motion, expressions, camera movement, and scene dynamics from a driving video. It can generate dancing, acting, gestures, fashion shots, and stylized human or creature performances while preserving the character's appearance.
model.animate2_ref_prompt: The person in the driving video performs an action while the background remains static.

prompt: Character appearance: a silver tabby cat with a round face, upright ears, and large round eyes, wearing a dark blue school uniform with gold buttons, a pleated skirt, a white shirt, and a red bow tie. Background: pure white, evenly lit, with no other objects or decorations.
negative_prompt: static pose, frozen motion, blurry, low quality, distorted body, deformed hands, extra limbs, unstable identity, flicker
alt_prompt: The person in the driving video performs an action while the background remains static.
